title: How I make animated videos with words + a chatbot

lines.text: Scroll. Scroll. Scroll... Same stuff, every night. I don't even know what I'm looking for anymore.
Social media is getting so drab. I've always wanted to make something that actually means something to me... but I'm just so tired.
I could draw, I guess.
But after working enough hours just to keep a roof over my head... and food in the fridge... there's nothing left.
Drawing every single frame by hand? I just... can't. Not right now.
Hey. I saw your comment. And honestly? I've been there.
Can I show you something that's been working for me? It takes way less energy than you'd think.
Okay... show me.
Step one. Find a spark. Something you write yourself: a feeling, a memory, a "what if."
lines.tts: Step one. Find a spark. Something you write yourself. A feeling... a memory... a what if.

lines.text: Or let someone else's post inspire you. A comment, a story, one sentence that sticks with you.
Like... my grandma teaching me to fold dumplings? I think about that a lot.
That's perfect. That's exactly the kind of thing.
Step two. You don't have to be a writer. Just ramble to a chatbot, like you're texting a friend.
Then ask it to shape your words into a short script. Scenes, characters, and what everyone says.
Wait... it took my thoughts, just as they were, and built a whole story from them?
Step three. Paste that script into an AI coding assistant. I use Claude Code. And ask it for an animated video.
It writes the code, draws the characters, gives them voices, adds music, and puts it all together.
No editing software to learn. It runs all the tools for you.
Hold on. It does all of that?
But... I don't know how to code.
You don't have to. You just talk to it in plain words, and it handles the code.
Okay... her arm is floating. And the music is way too loud.
Just say what you'd change. Since it's all made of code, it can fix a glitch, rewrite a line, or swap a whole scene, fast.
Watch. Tweak. Repeat. As many times as you want.
And if I end up hating it?
Then just say so. Nothing's wasted. It's just the next version.
Gently... like you're tucking it into bed.
That's her. That's really her.
And it's not just this style. Pixel art. Paper cut-outs. Maybe even 3D. Honestly, I'm still finding out what's possible.
lines.tts: And it's not just this style. Pixel art. Paper cut-outs. Maybe even three D. Honestly, I'm still finding out what's possible.

lines.text: Oh, and this video you're watching right now? Made exactly the same way.
You don't need energy you don't have. Just a spark, and a few honest words.
Some nights I only have twenty minutes in me. That's enough to move one scene forward.
Go make something that means something to you.
Okay. Let's make something.
